title: Lead Software Engineer, Platform and Delivery
description:
It's Lolly builds a hospitality technology suite (LollyPOS, LollyHQ, the Lolly App, SnapServe Pro, Self Serve kiosks, KVS, Lolly Move and Bedside Ordering) used by more than 225,000 people across education, healthcare, corporate catering and restaurants. We hold ISO 9001, 27001, 14001 and 42001 certifications, which means security, privacy and auditability are engineering requirements, not afterthoughts.

The Role:

You will own how software gets from a developer's branch to production. Today that path depends on people; your job is to make it depend on a pipeline. You will design and build continuous integration and delivery for a multi-tenant .NET estate (modern .NET services and APIs alongside a .NET Framework 4.8 WPF point-of-sale product), introduce automated testing, security scanning and traceability as standard gates, and make releases repeatable and auditable. As AI coding agents contribute more of our changes, the pipeline you build is the control that lets us validate human and agent work the same way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and own CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for .NET services, APIs, WPF desktop and mobile products.
  • Define branching, versioning, environment promotion and release approval standards, and automate them.
  • Introduce static analysis, dependency and secret scanning, and automated tests as pipeline gates, working with Quality Engineering on the test strategy.
  • Manage build and deployment infrastructure, environment configuration and secrets with least privilege access and full auditability.
  • Partner with the Head of Software Development on the architecture record and on the decisions that are hardest to reverse.
  • Coach developers in the squads on trunk-based development, test automation and safe use of AI coding tools.

Essential.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD for .NET applications (Azure DevOps Pipelines or GitHub Actions), including deployments to Windows and cloud targets.
  • Strong C# and .NET (modern .NET and .NET Framework 4.8) with the ability to read, review and fix application code, not only pipeline code.
  • SQL Server deployment practice: schema migrations, safe deployment to large multi-tenant databases, awareness of lock and transaction-log impact.
  • Infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM), secrets management (Azure Key Vault or equivalent) and least-privilege access design.
  • Practical security: dependency scanning, SAST, secure build chains, and evidencing controls for ISO 27001 or similar.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or similar) in a team, with a clear view of how their output should be validated.
  • Clear writing: you will produce the delivery plan, the standards and the audit evidence.

If you are an experienced Lead Software Engineer seeking an opportunity to work in an event-driven environment, close to product and shipping fast, then please send a copy of your CV directly to this job advertisement.
